newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bankers Trust ups China Light warrants.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust ups China Light warrants.

text.p: Bankers Trust International Plc said on Monday it would increase the size of its 64 million American style call warrant issue on shares of China Light & Power Co Ltd by a further 26 million warrants at HK$0.90 each.
The new price compares to the already-issued warrants' closing price of HK$0.91 on Friday, Bankers Trust said. The price at issue last month was HK$0.7967 per warrant.

Terms of the warrants remain unchanged. Ten warrants control one share at a strike price of HK$28.815 per share. The new warrants are expected to commence trading on October 3 and will expire on November 21, 1997. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
